title: Acme Registration API
description: HTTP service that validates and registers users in memory and pushes them to a CRM best effort.

constraints: Standard library only. No third-party modules.
gofmt clean and go vet clean.
Tests are table-driven and live next to the code they test.
notes: Out of scope: persistence beyond memory, auth, rate limiting, CRM retries, passwords.

tests.name: healthz responds
tests.command: sh -c 'go run ./cmd/acme-api & sleep 2; curl -sf localhost:8080/healthz | grep -qx ok; s=$?; kill %1; exit $s'
